blocks.en: Background, Alternatives, Implementation Recommendations and Application Submission

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Sterility Test 的四大科學局限性，以及這些局限如何驅動 CCIT 替代策略
blocks.en: Understand the four scientific limitations of the sterility test and how they drive the CCIT replacement strategy

blocks.zh: 掌握 FDA 認可的 CCIT 替代方法類型：物理/化學方法與微生物方法
blocks.en: Understand the types of alternative methods recognized by FDA: physical/chemical methods and microbiological methods

blocks.zh: 了解 CCIT 相較於 Sterility Test 的四大優勢
blocks.en: Understand the four advantages of CCIT over the sterility test

blocks.zh: 明確 CCIT 的實施要點：時間點限制、驗證要求、測試頻率
blocks.en: Be clear on the key points for implementing CCIT: time point restrictions, validation requirements and testing frequency

blocks.zh: 掌握不同產品類型 (Human Drugs, Biologics, Devices) 的法規申報途徑與 Supplement 類型
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory filing routes and supplement types for different product types (Human Drugs, Biologics, Devices)

blocks.zh: 認識 Bracketing Matrix、Media-filled Containers、樣品管理等實務考量
blocks.en: Recognize practical considerations such as the Bracketing Matrix, media-filled containers and sample management

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Sterility Test 的四大局限性：
blocks.en: The four limitations of the sterility test:

blocks.zh: 時間點限制 (Point-in-time): 只能檢測「測試當下」存在的活微生物。如果容器在 12 個月時有微洩漏但細菌尚未侵入，Sterility Test 可能呈陰性，但產品在 18 個月時卻已被污染
blocks.en: Point-in-time: It can only detect viable microorganisms present "at the moment of testing". If a container has a micro-leak at 12 months but bacteria have not yet entered, the sterility test may be negative, yet the product may already be contaminated at 18 months

blocks.zh: 培養基選擇性 (Media Selectivity): 僅能檢測在指定培養基中能生長的微生物。USP <71> 使用 FTM 和 TSB 兩種培養基，但某些極端環境微生物或嚴格厭氧菌可能無法被檢出
blocks.en: Media Selectivity: It can only detect microorganisms that can grow in the specified media. USP <71> uses two media, FTM and TSB, but some extremophiles or strict anaerobes may not be detected

blocks.zh: 偽陽性風險 (False Positive): 操作過程中的外來微生物污染 (Adventitious Contamination) 可能導致偽陽性，觸發昂貴的調查程序 (OOS Investigation)
blocks.en: False Positive: Adventitious contamination introduced during handling can cause a false positive and trigger an expensive investigation (OOS Investigation)

blocks.zh: 破壞性 (Destructive): 測試樣品被消耗，無法對同一樣品進行複檢或後續測試
blocks.en: Destructive: The test sample is consumed, so the same sample cannot be retested or used for subsequent testing

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Sterility Test 的局限性就像「用打開窗戶來檢查房子是否防盜」：
blocks.en: The limitations of the sterility test are like "checking whether a house is burglar-proof by opening its windows":

blocks.zh: 你只能看到「此刻」有沒有小偷在屋內（時間點限制）
blocks.en: You can only see whether a burglar is in the house "right now" (point-in-time limitation)

blocks.zh: 你只能認出你認識的小偷（培養基選擇性）
blocks.en: You can only recognize the burglars you know about (media selectivity)

blocks.zh: 開窗的動作本身就可能讓小偷趁機進入（偽陽性）
blocks.en: The act of opening the window may itself let a burglar in (false positive)

blocks.zh: 每次檢查都要拆掉一扇窗戶，不能再裝回去（破壞性）
blocks.en: Every inspection requires removing a window that cannot be put back (destructive)

blocks.zh: 相較之下，CCIT 就像用紅外線感測器從外部掃描門窗是否有縫隙——不需要破壞任何結構就能判斷防禦完整性。
blocks.en: By contrast, CCIT is like scanning the doors and windows from the outside with an infrared sensor to look for gaps: you can judge the integrity of the defenses without damaging any structure.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 歷史脈絡：FDA 早在 1993 年的 Sterilization Process Validation Guidance 中就指出「僅在初始時間點的無菌試驗不足以證明容器密封系統的微生物完整性」。從 1993 年到 2008 年，FDA 花了 15 年才正式發布此 CCIT Guidance，反映了科學共識的逐步建立過程。
blocks.en: Historical context: As early as the 1993 Sterilization Process Validation Guidance, FDA stated that "sterility testing at the initial time point alone is not sufficient to demonstrate the microbial integrity of the container closure system". It took FDA 15 years, from 1993 to 2008, to formally issue this CCIT Guidance, reflecting the gradual build-up of scientific consensus.

blocks.zh: ICH 安定性架構：本段引用的 ICH Guideline 後續演變為 ICH Q1A(R2)「Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products」**(ICH Q1A(R2), 2003)**，以及 ICH Q5C「Stability Testing of Biotechnological/Biological Products」。這些 ICH 指引建立了安定性測試的國際框架，本 FDA CCIT Guidance 是在此框架下的補充。
blocks.en: ICH stability framework: The ICH guideline cited in this paragraph later evolved into ICH Q1A(R2) "Stability Testing of New Drug Substances and Products" **(ICH Q1A(R2), 2003)** and ICH Q5C "Stability Testing of Biotechnological/Biological Products". These ICH guidelines established the international framework for stability testing, and this FDA CCIT Guidance supplements that framework.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 偽陽性的代價——CDMO 的痛點：一次 Sterility Test 偽陽性可能觸發以下連鎖反應：
blocks.en: The cost of a false positive, a CDMO pain point: A single false-positive sterility test can trigger the following chain reaction:

blocks.zh: OOS 調查啟動（通常需要 15-30 個工作天）
blocks.en: Start of an OOS investigation (usually 15-30 working days)

blocks.zh: 批次可能需要隔離等待調查結論
blocks.en: The batch may need to be quarantined pending the investigation conclusion

blocks.zh: 若無法在 30 天內結案，可能影響客戶的產品供應
blocks.en: If the investigation cannot be closed within 30 days, the client's product supply may be affected

blocks.zh: 調查人力成本（QA、QC、Production 多部門參與）
blocks.en: Investigation labor cost (multiple departments involved: QA, QC, Production)

blocks.zh: 客戶信任度下降，影響後續商業關係
blocks.en: Reduced client confidence, affecting the ongoing business relationship

blocks.zh: 採用 CCIT 取代安定性計畫中的 Sterility Test，可大幅降低此風險。
blocks.en: Replacing the sterility test in the stability program with CCIT can greatly reduce this risk.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Sterility Test 的四大局限性中，哪一項對 CDMO 的營運影響最大？為什麼？
blocks.en: Of the four limitations of the sterility test, which has the greatest impact on CDMO operations, and why?

blocks.zh: FDA 引用 1993 年 Guidance 的 quote 中提到「sterility testing at the initial time point is not considered sufficient」——這句話的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: FDA quotes the 1993 Guidance, which states that "sterility testing at the initial time point is not considered sufficient". What is the logic of this statement?

blocks.zh: 如果你的安定性計畫中某個時間點 Sterility Test 出現偽陽性，但 CCIT 結果正常，你會如何進行 OOS 調查？
blocks.en: If a sterility test at one time point of your stability program gives a false positive but the CCIT result is normal, how would you conduct the OOS investigation?

blocks.zh: V. Alternatives 替代方法
blocks.en: V. Alternatives

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法分類：FDA 將替代方法分為兩大類，這與後來 USP <1207> 的分類架構對應：
blocks.en: Classification of CCIT methods: FDA divides the alternative methods into two categories, which correspond to the later classification framework of USP <1207>:

blocks.zh: 1. 物理/化學方法 (Physical/Chemical Methods) — 對應 USP <1207> 的 Deterministic Methods (確定性方法)：
blocks.en: 1. Physical/Chemical Methods, corresponding to the Deterministic Methods of USP <1207>:

blocks.zh: Bubble Test (氣泡測試): 將容器浸入液體中施加壓力，觀察是否有氣泡產生
blocks.en: Bubble Test: The container is immersed in liquid and pressure is applied; the test observes whether bubbles are generated

blocks.zh: Pressure/Vacuum Decay (壓力/真空衰減法): 測量容器內壓力變化速率，偏差表示有洩漏
blocks.en: Pressure/Vacuum Decay: Measures the rate of pressure change inside the container; a deviation indicates a leak

blocks.zh: Trace Gas Permeation/Leak Test (示蹤氣體滲透法): 使用 Helium 等示蹤氣體，以質譜儀檢測洩漏。靈敏度極高
blocks.en: Trace Gas Permeation/Leak Test: Uses a tracer gas such as helium and detects leaks with a mass spectrometer. Extremely sensitive

blocks.zh: Dye Penetration Test (染料滲透法): 將容器浸入染料溶液，檢測是否有染料侵入。此為概率性方法
blocks.en: Dye Penetration Test: The container is immersed in a dye solution and checked for dye ingress. This is a probabilistic method

blocks.zh: Seal Force Test (密封力測試): 測量密封件的夾持力/壓縮力
blocks.en: Seal Force Test: Measures the gripping/compression force of the closure

blocks.zh: Electrical Conductivity/Capacitance (電導/電容法): 利用電性測量檢測密封缺陷
blocks.en: Electrical Conductivity/Capacitance: Uses electrical measurements to detect seal defects

blocks.zh: 2. 微生物方法 (Microbiological Methods) — 對應 USP <1207> 的 Probabilistic Methods (概率性方法)：
blocks.en: 2. Microbiological Methods, corresponding to the Probabilistic Methods of USP <1207>:

blocks.zh: Microbial Challenge/Immersion Test (微生物挑戰/浸沒試驗): 將容器浸入含微生物的液體中，觀察是否有微生物侵入
blocks.en: Microbial Challenge/Immersion Test: The container is immersed in a liquid containing microorganisms, and the test observes whether microorganisms have entered

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法的選擇就像「檢查輪胎是否漏氣」的不同方式：
blocks.en: The different CCIT methods are like different ways of "checking a tire for air leaks":

blocks.zh: Bubble Test: 把輪胎泡在水裡看有沒有氣泡——簡單直觀，但靈敏度有限
blocks.en: Bubble Test: Put the tire in water and look for bubbles: simple and intuitive, but with limited sensitivity

blocks.zh: Pressure Decay: 用氣壓計監測輪胎氣壓是否隨時間下降——定量且精確
blocks.en: Pressure Decay: Use a pressure gauge to monitor whether the tire pressure drops over time: quantitative and accurate

blocks.zh: Helium Leak Test: 灌入特殊示蹤氣體，用精密儀器偵測——可以找到極微小的洩漏
blocks.en: Helium Leak Test: Fill with a special tracer gas and detect it with a precision instrument: can find extremely small leaks

blocks.zh: Dye Penetration: 在輪胎外塗上有色液體看有沒有滲入——視覺化但需時間
blocks.en: Dye Penetration: Coat the outside of the tire with a colored liquid and see whether it seeps in: visual but time-consuming

blocks.zh: Microbial Challenge: 把輪胎放在泥水中泡一段時間看內部有沒有進泥水——最接近真實風險但效率低
blocks.en: Microbial Challenge: Leave the tire in muddy water for a while and see whether any gets inside: closest to real-world risk but inefficient

blocks.zh: CCIT 的四大優勢（對應 Sterility Test 的四大局限）：
blocks.en: The four advantages of CCIT (corresponding to the four limitations of the sterility test):

blocks.zh: 預防性檢測 (Proactive): 可在微生物侵入之前就偵測到容器洩漏——從「被動發現污染」轉變為「主動發現風險」
blocks.en: Proactive: Container leaks can be detected before microorganisms enter, shifting from "discovering contamination reactively" to "discovering risk proactively"

blocks.zh: 非破壞性 (Non-destructive): 部分方法（如 Vacuum Decay、Helium Leak）不破壞樣品，測試後可繼續用於其他安定性項目
blocks.en: Non-destructive: Some methods (such as Vacuum Decay and Helium Leak) do not damage the sample, so it can continue to be used for other stability attributes after testing

blocks.zh: 快速 (Rapid): 數分鐘至數小時可完成，對比 Sterility Test 至少 7 天（USP <71> 規定細菌培養基 14 天）
blocks.en: Rapid: Completed within minutes to hours, compared with at least 7 days for the sterility test (USP <71> specifies 14 days for the bacterial media)

blocks.zh: 低偽陽性 (Low False Positive): 物理方法不涉及微生物操作，偽陽性風險大幅降低
blocks.en: Low False Positive: Physical methods do not involve handling microorganisms, so the false-positive risk is greatly reduced

blocks.zh: Preservative Effectiveness Test (PET) 不可替代 CCIT：FDA 明確否決了以 PET（USP <51>）替代 Sterility Test 的提案。PET 只測試防腐劑對 5 種特定微生物的效力，無法確認產品是否無菌，也無法評估容器密封完整性。但 PET 仍應納入多劑量容器 (Multi-dose Containers) 的安定性計畫中。
blocks.en: The Preservative Effectiveness Test (PET) cannot replace CCIT: FDA explicitly rejected the proposal to replace the sterility test with PET (USP <51>). PET only tests the efficacy of the preservative against 5 specific microorganisms; it cannot confirm that the product is sterile or evaluate container closure integrity. However, PET should still be included in the stability program for multi-dose containers.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — USP <1207> 的現代分類
blocks.en: Key Notes: Modern Classification under USP <1207>

blocks.zh: 2008 年此 Guidance 發布時，USP <1207> 尚未建立。如今 USP <1207> 將 CCI 測試方法系統化為：
blocks.en: When this Guidance was issued in 2008, USP <1207> had not yet been established. Today USP <1207> systematizes CCI test methods as follows:

blocks.zh: Deterministic Methods (確定性方法): 基於物理/化學原理，結果具確定性（通過/不通過）。包括 Helium Leak Test、Vacuum Decay、High-Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD)、Laser-based Headspace Analysis 等 **(USP <1207.1>)**
blocks.en: Deterministic Methods: Based on physical/chemical principles, with deterministic results (pass/fail). They include Helium Leak Test, Vacuum Decay, High-Voltage Leak Detection (HVLD), Laser-based Headspace Analysis and others **(USP <1207.1>)**

blocks.zh: Probabilistic Methods (概率性方法): 基於統計概率，結果有統計不確定性。包括 Dye Ingress、Microbial Immersion/Aerosol Challenge **(USP <1207.2>)**
blocks.en: Probabilistic Methods: Based on statistical probability, with statistical uncertainty in the results. They include Dye Ingress and Microbial Immersion/Aerosol Challenge **(USP <1207.2>)**

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 明確要求優先使用 Deterministic Methods **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**。對 CDMO 而言，建議優先導入確定性方法，以符合最新法規期望。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) explicitly requires that Deterministic Methods be used preferentially **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**. For a CDMO, it is advisable to implement deterministic methods first, in order to meet the latest regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: Deterministic Methods 與 Probabilistic Methods 的根本差異為何？為什麼 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 要求優先使用確定性方法？
blocks.en: What is the fundamental difference between Deterministic Methods and Probabilistic Methods? Why does PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) require preferential use of deterministic methods?

blocks.zh: Preservative Effectiveness Test 為什麼不能作為 CCIT 的替代？從「測試目的」的角度分析。
blocks.en: Why can the Preservative Effectiveness Test not be used as an alternative to CCIT? Analyze from the angle of "test purpose".

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 計畫導入 Vacuum Decay 方法用於 Vial 系統的安定性 CCIT。請列出驗證計畫的主要項目。
blocks.en: Your CDMO plans to implement the Vacuum Decay method for stability CCIT of a vial system. List the main items of the validation plan.

blocks.zh: 一款含防腐劑的多劑量眼藥水產品，安定性計畫中應同時包含哪些測試？（提示：CCIT 與 PET 各有其角色）
blocks.en: A multi-dose eye drop product containing a preservative: which tests should the stability program include together? (Hint: CCIT and PET each have their own role)

blocks.zh: VI. Implementation 實施建議
blocks.en: VI. Implementation

blocks.zh: Implementation 四大要點解析：
blocks.en: Analysis of the four key points of Implementation:

blocks.zh: 1. 時間點限制：CCIT 可以取代安定性計畫中放行後各時間點的 Sterility Test（如 3M、6M、12M、24M、36M 等），但放行時間點 (T=0) 的 Sterility Test 不可被替代。這是因為放行 Sterility Test 驗證的是「製程是否成功產出無菌產品」，CCIT 無法回答此問題。
blocks.en: 1. Time point restriction: CCIT can replace the sterility test at the post-release time points of the stability program (e.g., 3M, 6M, 12M, 24M, 36M), but the sterility test at the release time point (T=0) cannot be replaced. This is because the release sterility test verifies "whether the process has successfully produced a sterile product", a question CCIT cannot answer.

blocks.zh: 2. 放行無菌試驗不可替代：再次強調此核心限制。USP <71> Sterility Test 仍為放行的法定要求。
blocks.en: 2. Release sterility testing cannot be replaced: This core limitation bears repeating. The USP <71> sterility test remains the statutory requirement for release.

blocks.zh: 3. Validation (驗證) 要求：CCIT 方法必須經過驗證，且驗證需證明該方法能夠偵測容器密封完整性的缺陷 (Breach)。「Adequately Validated」的標準是透過科學接受的研究證明。
blocks.en: 3. Validation requirements: The CCIT method must be validated, and the validation must demonstrate that the method can detect breaches in container closure integrity. The standard of "adequately validated" is met by demonstration through scientifically accepted studies.

blocks.zh: 4. 測試頻率：至少每年一次及效期時執行。此頻率與多數安定性計畫的測試時間點吻合（通常 3M、6M、9M、12M、18M、24M、36M）。
blocks.en: 4. Testing frequency: At least once a year and at expiry. This frequency matches the time points of most stability programs (usually 3M, 6M, 9M, 12M, 18M, 24M, 36M).

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家倉儲公司，負責保管客戶的貴重物品。出門前檢查瓦斯（放行 Sterility Test）是必做的——你必須確認交接時物品是完好的。但之後的定期巡檢（安定性計畫），你可以選擇用監視器（CCIT）而不是每次都開門查看（Sterility Test）。監視器需要先經過校準和測試（驗證），而巡檢頻率至少一年一次加上合約到期時（效期）。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a warehousing company that stores valuable goods for clients. Checking the gas before leaving the premises (the release sterility test) is mandatory: you must confirm the goods are intact at handover. But for the periodic patrols afterwards (the stability program), you may choose to use surveillance cameras (CCIT) instead of opening the door and looking every time (the sterility test). The cameras must first be calibrated and tested (validation), and the patrol frequency is at least once a year, plus when the contract ends (expiry).

blocks.zh: 驗證要點——與 USP <1207> 銜接：
blocks.en: Validation points, linking to USP <1207>:

blocks.zh: Method Suitability (方法適用性): 確認所選 CCIT 方法與目標容器密封系統相容，且不受產品配方干擾 **(USP <1207.1>)**
blocks.en: Method Suitability: Confirm that the selected CCIT method is compatible with the target container closure system and is not affected by interference from the product formulation **(USP <1207.1>)**

blocks.zh: Limit of Detection (檢測極限): 確定方法能偵測到的最小洩漏尺寸。確定性方法通常以 Leak Rate (如 atm·cc/sec) 或 Maximum Allowable Leakage Limit (MALL) 表示
blocks.en: Limit of Detection: Determine the smallest leak size the method can detect. For deterministic methods this is usually expressed as a Leak Rate (e.g., atm·cc/sec) or as the Maximum Allowable Leakage Limit (MALL)

blocks.zh: Positive Controls (陽性對照): 使用已知缺陷的樣品（如 Laser-drilled Vials）驗證方法的偵測能力
blocks.en: Positive Controls: Use samples with known defects (e.g., laser-drilled vials) to verify the detection capability of the method

blocks.zh: Product Compatibility (產品相容性): 確認產品特性（如黏度、表面張力、含氣量）不影響測試結果
blocks.en: Product Compatibility: Confirm that product characteristics (e.g., viscosity, surface tension, dissolved gas content) do not affect the test results

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的強化要求：PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.21 進一步要求 CCI 測試方法應具有「適當的靈敏度」(appropriate sensitivity)，並優先使用確定性方法。這比 2008 年此 FDA Guidance 的要求更為具體 **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**。
blocks.en: Enhanced requirements in PIC/S Annex 1 (2022): PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.21 further requires that CCI test methods have "appropriate sensitivity" and that deterministic methods be used preferentially. This is more specific than the requirements of this 2008 FDA Guidance **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 目前在安定性計畫中 T=0、12M、24M、36M 執行 Sterility Test。若要改為 CCIT，哪些時間點可以替代？哪個不行？
blocks.en: Your CDMO currently performs sterility tests at T=0, 12M, 24M and 36M in the stability program. If you switch to CCIT, which time points can be replaced and which cannot?

blocks.en: If a product contains a high concentration of protein, which CCIT methods might be affected by interference? How can this be resolved?

blocks.zh: VII. Application Submission 申請提交
blocks.en: VII. Application Submission

blocks.zh: 法規申報途徑：
blocks.en: Regulatory filing routes:

blocks.zh: Human Drugs — CBE Supplement (§ 314.70):「Changes Being Effected」(CBE) Supplement 是一種無需 FDA 事先核准即可實施變更的申報類型。提交後即可開始執行，但 FDA 保留審查後要求修改的權利。這反映了 FDA 將 CCIT 替代視為低風險變更
blocks.en: Human Drugs, CBE Supplement (§ 314.70): A "Changes Being Effected" (CBE) Supplement is a type of filing that allows a change to be implemented without prior FDA approval. Implementation can begin after submission, although FDA reserves the right to require modifications after review. This reflects FDA's view of the CCIT replacement as a low-risk change

blocks.zh: Biological Products — CBE Supplement (§ 601.12): 生物製品適用類似的 CBE 途徑
blocks.en: Biological Products, CBE Supplement (§ 601.12): A similar CBE route applies to biological products

blocks.zh: Medical Devices — PMA Supplement (§ 814.39): 醫療器械需提交 PMA Supplement，審查標準較嚴格
blocks.en: Medical Devices, PMA Supplement (§ 814.39): Medical devices must submit a PMA Supplement, with a stricter review standard

blocks.zh: Bracketing Matrix (分群矩陣): 參考 ICH Q1D「Bracketing and Matrixing Designs for Stability Testing」**(ICH Q1D, 2003)**。若多個產品使用相同容器密封系統，可透過 Bracketing 策略選擇代表性組合進行驗證，無需對每個產品重複完整驗證。
blocks.en: Bracketing Matrix: See ICH Q1D "Bracketing and Matrixing Designs for Stability Testing" **(ICH Q1D, 2003)**. If multiple products use the same container closure system, a bracketing strategy can be used to select representative combinations for validation, without repeating the full validation for every product.

blocks.zh: Media-filled Containers (培養基充填容器): 以培養基替代實際產品進行 CCIT 驗證，可避免產品成分（如防腐劑）對測試結果的干擾。
blocks.en: Media-filled Containers: Using culture media instead of the actual product for CCIT validation avoids interference from product components (such as preservatives) with the test results.

blocks.zh: Bracketing Matrix 的效率：就像一家鞋廠要測試鞋子的防水性。如果你有 10 種不同款式但都使用相同的 Gore-Tex 防水層和相同的縫線技術，你不需要把 10 種款式都泡水 48 小時。選擇最大和最小尺寸、最複雜和最簡單的款式（極端條件）進行測試即可代表整體。這就是 Bracketing 的概念——用科學設計的子集代表全體。
blocks.en: Efficiency of the Bracketing Matrix: Consider a shoe factory that wants to test the waterproofing of its shoes. If you have 10 different styles that all use the same Gore-Tex waterproof layer and the same stitching technique, you do not need to soak all 10 styles in water for 48 hours. It is enough to test the largest and smallest sizes and the most complex and simplest styles (extreme conditions) to represent the whole. This is the concept of Bracketing: a scientifically designed subset represents the whole.

blocks.zh: 樣品管理的關鍵規則：
blocks.en: Key rules for sample management:

blocks.zh: 可重複使用：通過 CCIT 的樣品可繼續用於同一測試時間點的其他安定性項目（如含量測定、pH、外觀等），前提是 CCIT 方法為非破壞性且不改變樣品
blocks.en: Reusable: Samples that have passed CCIT can continue to be used for other stability attributes at the same test time point (e.g., assay, pH, appearance), provided that the CCIT method is non-destructive and does not alter the sample

blocks.zh: 不可跨時間點使用：在 12 個月時間點測試 CCIT 的樣品，不可保留到 24 個月時再用於其他安定性測試。此規則確保每個時間點的樣品都是從原始安定性存放條件中直接取出的
blocks.en: Not usable across time points: Samples tested by CCIT at the 12-month time point must not be kept until 24 months and then used for other stability tests. This rule ensures that the samples for each time point are taken directly from the original stability storage conditions

blocks.zh: 統計適當的樣品數：樣品數必須「統計適當」(Statistically Appropriate)，但 FDA 未指定具體數量。實務上通常參考 USP <1207> 和 PDA TR27 的建議
blocks.en: Statistically appropriate sample size: The number of samples must be "statistically appropriate", but FDA does not specify a number. In practice, the recommendations of USP <1207> and PDA TR27 are usually followed

blocks.zh: Supplement 中應包含的內容：
blocks.en: What the supplement should include:

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法的描述及其如何評估微生物完整性
blocks.en: A description of the CCIT method and how it evaluates microbial integrity

blocks.zh: 方法驗證數據（針對具體容器密封系統或產品類型）
blocks.en: Method validation data (for the specific container closure system or product type)

blocks.zh: 若使用 Media-filled Containers，需提供支持數據
blocks.en: If Media-filled Containers are used, supporting data

blocks.zh: 若使用 Bracketing Matrix，需說明分群設計的科學依據
blocks.en: If a Bracketing Matrix is used, the scientific rationale for the bracketing design

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: Bracketing 策略的效率計算：
blocks.en: Efficiency calculation for a bracketing strategy:

blocks.zh:
完整驗證方案：4 products × 3 batches × 30 samples = 360 units
Bracketing 方案：2 products (6R + 20R) × 3 batches × 30 samples = 180 units

節省比例 = (360 - 180) / 360 = 50%
節省成本 = 驗證時間 + 樣品成本 + 分析人力
blocks.en:
Full validation plan: 4 products × 3 batches × 30 samples = 360 units
Bracketing plan: 2 products (6R + 20R) × 3 batches × 30 samples = 180 units

Savings ratio = (360 - 180) / 360 = 50%
Savings = validation time + sample cost + analytical labor

blocks.zh: （實際樣品數應依統計設計與 FDA 期望調整）
blocks.en: (The actual number of samples should be adjusted according to the statistical design and FDA expectations)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 允許使用 CBE Supplement（而非 Prior Approval Supplement）來申報 CCIT 替代？這反映了 FDA 對此變更風險等級的什麼判斷？
blocks.en: Why does FDA allow a CBE Supplement (rather than a Prior Approval Supplement) for filing the CCIT replacement? What does this reflect about FDA's judgment of the risk level of this change?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 有一款含防腐劑的多劑量注射液產品，計畫在安定性計畫中導入 CCIT。是否應使用 Media-filled Containers？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has a multi-dose injectable product containing a preservative and plans to introduce CCIT into its stability program. Should Media-filled Containers be used? Why?

blocks.zh: 一個樣品在 12 個月時間點完成 CCIT（通過），然後被用於 Appearance 和 pH 測試。這是否符合 FDA 的規則？如果該樣品被保留到 24 個月再測 Appearance，是否合規？
blocks.en: A sample completes CCIT (pass) at the 12-month time point and is then used for Appearance and pH testing. Does this comply with FDA's rules? If the sample is kept until 24 months and then tested for Appearance, is that compliant?

blocks.zh: 設計一個 Bracketing Matrix：你的 CDMO 有 3 種產品使用 2R、10R、50mL vial，搭配同一型號 stopper 和 crimp seal。哪些組合是 Bracket 的端點？
blocks.en: Design a Bracketing Matrix: your CDMO has 3 products using 2R, 10R and 50 mL vials, with the same stopper and crimp seal model. Which combinations are the bracket end points?

blocks.zh: FDA 鼓勵「develop innovative methods」——請舉出一個 2008 年後發展的創新 CCIT 方法，說明其原理和優勢。（提示：Headspace Analysis, HVLD）
blocks.en: FDA encourages manufacturers to "develop innovative methods". Name one innovative CCIT method developed after 2008 and describe its principle and advantages. (Hint: Headspace Analysis, HVLD)

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 Bracketing 策略範例：
blocks.en: Example of a CDMO bracketing strategy:

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 使用以下容器密封系統：
blocks.en: Assume your CDMO uses the following container closure systems:

blocks.zh: 由於 Products A/B/C/D 使用相同的 Stopper 和 Crimp Seal 類型，可使用 Bracketing 策略：選擇最小 (6R) 和最大 (20R) Vial Size 進行完整驗證，中間尺寸的驗證可簡化。這可將驗證工作量減少 40-50%。
blocks.en: Because Products A/B/C/D use the same Stopper and Crimp Seal types, a bracketing strategy can be applied: perform full validation on the smallest (6R) and largest (20R) vial sizes, and the validation of the intermediate sizes can be simplified. This can reduce the validation workload by 40-50%.

blocks.zh: 申報策略：對於已核准產品，以 CBE Supplement 提交。附件應包含：(1) CCIT 方法描述、(2) 驗證報告、(3) Bracketing Matrix 的科學理由、(4) 修訂後的安定性計畫。提交後即可開始執行新的安定性計畫。
blocks.en: Filing strategy: For approved products, submit as a CBE Supplement. The attachments should include: (1) a description of the CCIT method, (2) the validation report, (3) the scientific rationale for the Bracketing Matrix, and (4) the revised stability program. The new stability program can be implemented after submission.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Sterility Test 四大局限：時間點限制、培養基選擇性、偽陽性風險、破壞性——這些科學局限是推動 CCIT 替代的根本原因
blocks.en: Four limitations of the sterility test: Point-in-time, media selectivity, false-positive risk and destructiveness. These scientific limitations are the fundamental reason for the CCIT replacement

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法分類：物理/化學方法（Bubble Test、Pressure/Vacuum Decay、Trace Gas、Dye Penetration、Seal Force、Electrical）與微生物方法（Microbial Challenge），對應 USP <1207> 的 Deterministic vs. Probabilistic 分類
blocks.en: CCIT method classification: Physical/chemical methods (Bubble Test, Pressure/Vacuum Decay, Trace Gas, Dye Penetration, Seal Force, Electrical) and microbiological methods (Microbial Challenge), corresponding to the Deterministic vs. Probabilistic classification of USP <1207>

blocks.zh: CCIT 四大優勢：預防性檢測（污染前偵測）、非破壞性（節省樣品）、快速（分鐘級）、低偽陽性
blocks.en: Four advantages of CCIT: Proactive (detection before contamination), non-destructive (saves samples), rapid (minutes), and low false-positive rate

blocks.zh: PET 不可替代 CCIT：Preservative Effectiveness Test 只測防腐劑效力，無法確認無菌性或容器完整性
blocks.en: PET cannot replace CCIT: The Preservative Effectiveness Test only tests preservative efficacy and cannot confirm sterility or container integrity

blocks.zh: 實施限制：CCIT 不可取代放行 Sterility Test；方法須經驗證；至少年度及效期執行
blocks.en: Implementation limits: CCIT cannot replace the release sterility test; the method must be validated; testing at least annually and at expiry

blocks.zh: 申報途徑：Human Drugs 與 Biologics 使用 CBE Supplement；Medical Devices 使用 PMA Supplement
blocks.en: Filing routes: Human Drugs and Biologics use a CBE Supplement; Medical Devices use a PMA Supplement

blocks.zh: 效率工具：Bracketing Matrix (ICH Q1D) 可大幅減少多產品驗證工作量；Media-filled Containers 可解決產品干擾問題
blocks.en: Efficiency tools: The Bracketing Matrix (ICH Q1D) can greatly reduce the validation workload for multiple products; Media-filled Containers can resolve product interference issues

blocks.zh: 樣品管理：非破壞性 CCIT 後的樣品可用於同時間點其他測試，但不可跨時間點重複使用
blocks.en: Sample management: Samples can be used for other tests at the same time point after non-destructive CCIT, but must not be reused across time points

blocks.zh: 現代化銜接：USP <1207> (2016) 與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 已進一步系統化 CCI 方法分類，並要求優先使用確定性方法
blocks.en: Link to modern standards: USP <1207> (2016) and PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) have further systematized the classification of CCI methods and require preferential use of deterministic methods
